summary: Ann Arbor, Michigan, former board member of the Inter-Cooperative Council, strong advocate for student-athlete welfare and integrity in college sports, critical of sports media and bloggers, experienced in business management and corporate leadership, knowledgeable about college athletics and their ethical implications, passionate about education and community engagement, enjoys football and has attended over 100 Michigan football games, believes in the importance of integrity and ethics in sports and business, critical of political and social injustices, values compassion and kindness in interactions, interested in the intersection of technology and society, supports democratic values and community responsibility.
